preservation.scope: Targeted content and program corrections documented in audit_fix_review.json; before-repair evidence preserved as history.

content_binding.scope: Reviewed text, formulas, quotes, page links and structure. Program bodies are checked against standalone sources separately. Snapshot equality is a change guard, not a mathematical proof.

program_checks.check_scope: HTML/source consistency, reviewed-content change guard, numeric references and execution. These checks do not prove all translated statements or mathematical arguments.

source_page_number_check.scope: Number and starting-page correspondence; translated text and proofs require mathematical/source review.

additional_seed_checks.scope: Isolated seed substitutions; original displayed fixed-seed sources remain unchanged. Finite statistical checks do not prove distributional correctness.

browser_review.visual_scope: Nine repair screenshots and no-JS screenshot individually inspected; actual browser PDF print inspected on first, example and final exercise pages; all-page rendered formula and bounded interaction checks.
